components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: var(--color-rose, #E9A4A8); color: var(--color-charcoal, #2B2628); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Montserrat', sans-serif); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; border: 2px solid transparent; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(233, 164, 168, 0.42); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-rose-hover, #DF8D92); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(233, 164, 168, 0.55); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-charcoal, #2B2628); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

Infância

components.css: .ds-pillar-card { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-rose-soft, #FBF0F1) 0%, var(--color-white, #FFFFFF) 38%); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #EFE4DF); border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: 2.25rem; max-width: 24rem; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(43, 38, 40, 0.07); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Montserrat', sans-serif); } .ds-pillar-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; } .ds-pillar-icon { width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; border-radius: 1.25rem; background-color: var(--color-rose, #E9A4A8); color: var(--color-charcoal, #2B2628); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-pillar-badge { padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; background-color: var(--color-cream-soft, #FDF9F3); color: var(--color-charcoal, #2B2628); } .ds-pillar-title { font-family: var(--font-heading, 'Dashing Personal', 'Outfit', sans-serif); font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-charcoal, #2B2628); margin: 0 0 0.625rem; } .ds-pillar-text { font-size: 0.925rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-charcoal-soft, #4F4649); margin: 0 0 1.25rem; } .ds-pillar-list { list-style: none; padding: 1rem 0 0; margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border, #EFE4DF); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-pillar-list li { position: relative; padding-left: 1.4rem; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--color-charcoal, #2B2628); } .ds-pillar-list li::before { content: '✦'; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; color: var(--color-rose, #E9A4A8); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.northStar: O Consultório Acolhedor em Giz Pastel (The Pastel Crayon Sanctuary)
narrative.overview:
The visual identity and web design system of Ingrid Cunha — Psicóloga Infantojuvenil (CRP 13/12719) embody four core brand pillars established in the Visual Identity Manual: Acolhimento (soft colors and rounded forms), Ludicidade (organic crayon/dry-brush textures evoking childhood), Profissionalismo e Limpeza (modern, highly legible sans-serif typography), and Humanização (affection, active listening, and healthy development). The mood is welcoming, ludic, serene, and ethical—translating the tactile warmth of the brand's stationery, ceramic mugs (assets/canecas-2.png), and editorial posters (assets/Brand Identity - Ingrid.png) into a digital space where parents and adolescents immediately feel safe.

Every surface balances the tenderness of hand-drawn pastel motifs—the three-arch dry-brush rainbow with its four-point star (assets/logo.png), scribbled crayon hearts (assets/coracao.png), stars, clouds, and spirals—with the structured clarity required to explain Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (TCC) and Neuropsychology to families. The system explicitly rejects two visual extremes: sterile, cold hospital-white clinical interfaces on one side, and overstimulating, primary-color daycare aesthetics or aggressive commercial sales funnels on the other.
keyCharacteristics: Luminous pastel triad (Rosa Acolhimento, Amarelo Baunilha, Azul Serenidade) grounded by warm vanilla-cream (#FDF9F3) and pure white (#FFFFFF) breathing room.
High-contrast soft charcoal typography (#2B2628, #4F4649, #594F53) over light and pastel surfaces to achieve WCAG AA/AAA readability without harsh pure black.

Authentic crayon and dry-brush graphical motifs (assets/logo.png, assets/coracao.png, rainbow, cloud, spiral, and 4/5-point star doodles) used as purposeful focal anchors around portraits and callouts.
Soft, tactile, and reassuring components with generous corner radii (0.75rem to 2.5rem and full 9999px pills) and gentle 2px hover lifts.

rules.name: The Charcoal-On-Pastel Rule
rules.body: Never place pure white body text or button labels directly over #E9A4A8, #F6DEBC, or #BAE5ED on light UI components; always pair pastel fills with Chumbo Suave (#2B2628) so every CTA button, eyebrow badge, and triad pill passes WCAG AA/AAA effortlessly.

rules.name: The Official Palette Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Never introduce external saturated greens, corporate blues, or diagnostic reds—including neon WhatsApp green buttons. Every WhatsApp CTA uses Rosa Acolhimento (#E9A4A8) with Chumbo Suave (#2B2628) text to preserve the serene therapeutic atmosphere.

rules.name: The Warm Canvas Rule
rules.body: Never leave the entire page on stark #FFFFFF; alternate sections between Creme Baunilha Suavizado (#FDF9F3), Branco Puro (#FFFFFF), and soft pastel gradients so families experience a warm, stationery-like tactile rhythm.

rules.name: The 13px Minimum Floor Rule
rules.body: No text token or caption may drop below 0.8125rem (13px), ensuring that CRP numbers, LGPD notices, and microcopy remain effortlessly legible on mobile screens for parents reading under stress.

rules.name: The Marker Highlight Rule
rules.body: Use the .text-highlight vanilla underline bar (height: 0.36em in #F6DEBC behind the baseline) at most once per primary headline to draw the eye to the core emotional benefit ("compreender emoções").

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never use pure black (rgba(0, 0, 0, ...)) or high-opacity drop shadows; every shadow must use either warm charcoal (rgba(43, 38, 40, 0.05–0.10)) or rose-tinted ambient light (rgba(233, 164, 168, 0.22–0.55)).

dos: Do use only the four official Visual Identity Manual colors (#E9A4A8, #F6DEBC, #BAE5ED, #FFFFFF) and their documented warm-cream/charcoal support tokens (#FDF9F3, #FBF0F1, #DF8D92, #EEF9FB, #EFE4DF, #2B2628, #4F4649, #594F53).
Do pair pastel fills (#E9A4A8, #F6DEBC, #BAE5ED) with Chumbo Suave (#2B2628) text so buttons, badges, and step indicators maintain >8:1 WCAG AAA contrast.

Do use the official brand assets (assets/logo.png, assets/ingrid.png, assets/coracao.png, assets/canecas-2.png, assets/icons/insta.png) with explicit width and height attributes and preserve a light badge (#FFFFFF or #FDF9F3) behind assets/logo.png when placed over dark surfaces like .site-footer.
Do route every WhatsApp conversion button through .js-whatsapp-link and WHATSAPP_CONFIG in js/main.js, preserving [data-track] attributes for GTM/GA4 and Meta Pixel measurement.
donts: Don't introduce external saturated accent colors—especially neon WhatsApp greens (#25D366), clinical blues, or alarmist reds—anywhere in the UI.
Don't place pure white (#FFFFFF) body text or button labels directly on pastel #E9A4A8, #F6DEBC, or #BAE5ED backgrounds where contrast drops below WCAG AA.
Don't use sharp 0px corners, cold gray backgrounds, or heavy black drop shadows that break the welcoming, child-friendly sanctuary atmosphere.
Don't include diagnostic checklists, promises of cure, patient testimonials, or identifiable photos of real children (strict CFP ethical prohibition).
